description: This is a unit test source file for testing network information related classes in the WPEFramework project, including adapters, IPv4 and IPv6 address iterators, and adapter observers.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator for network adapters, providing access to their IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and properties.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator for IPv4 addresses associated with network adapters.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator for IPv6 addresses associated with network adapters.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for network adapter notifications.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next address or adapter.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses or adapters.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the adapter.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current adapter or address is valid.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname associated with the address.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the host address in string form.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an address to the adapter.

methods.name: Gateway
methods.description: Sets the gateway address for the adapter.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an address from the adapter.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Brings the adapter up or down.

methods.name: IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is up.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is running.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the adapter.
